svg.aria-label: The GPU kernel decodes from the leaves up, one depth at a time, with two buffers that swap roles. At depth 2 the b and c leaves write b b c into the lane buffer. At depth 1 the a leaf writes five a into scratch and the b or c node merges with its bitmap 010, giving b c b. At depth 0 the root merges with 01010100 from scratch back into the lane buffer, giving a b a c a b a a.
svg.text: 1 at depth 2 the leaves b and c write b b c into the lane buffer
2 at depth 1 a writes five a; b or c merges with 010 into scratch
3 at depth 0 the root merges with 01010100 back into the lane buffer
4 two buffers that swap roles at every level, no third one needed
from leaves to root, each node merges its two children by its bitmap
